title: Explicit standard-WOFOST one-day evolution event contract

scope.safe_initial_admission: one B1.10-equivalent crop window of exactly one day

public_semantic_operation.conceptual_signature: evolve_crop(parameters, committed_crop_state, crop_event_forcing, accepted_process_aggregates, t0, t1) -> candidate_crop_state + crop_results + diagnostics

required_internal_window_phases.conceptual_operation: prepare_crop_window(parameters, committed_crop_checkpoint, crop_event_forcing, t0, t1) -> trial_local_crop_window_context
required_internal_window_phases.legacy_equivalent: flDayStart WOFOST assimilation before soil-water substeps
candidate_only_state_changes: atmin7 shift and insertion of current TMN
derived_window_context: daylength value needed by day-end phenology
optional oxygen/root-respiration same-window factors when that physics is active
required_internal_window_phases.reason: B1.10 day-start assimilation feeds same-day soil/root physics, so a day-end-only black box cannot reproduce the source call graph for every active standard-WOFOST option

required_internal_window_phases.conceptual_operation: accumulate only accepted soil/root process contributions over [t0,t1]
inputs: accepted aeration/oxygen-factor contributions only when active

required_internal_window_phases.conceptual_operation: finalize_crop_window(parameters, trial_local_crop_window_context, frozen_accepted_process_aggregates, committed_crop_checkpoint, t0, t1) -> complete candidate crop continuation
required_internal_window_phases.legacy_equivalent: cropdevelopment(3) at flDayEnd followed by option-dependent root extension/distribution
ordered_updates: standard phenology rate and anthesis transition
actual WOFOST biomass, organ and leaf-cohort update
option-dependent root-history update after WOFOST using same-window GRRT and accepted aggregates
required_internal_window_phases.candidate_publication_allowed: only as an F-KT candidate after the entire requested parent interval has been accepted

temporal_semantics.crop_process_cadence: one-day event for first admission because the source physics/call structure is daily

threshold_semantics.emergence: explicit lifecycle event before an emerged crop's first prepare phase
threshold_semantics.anthesis: daily transition may truncate DVR so candidate DVS lands on 1 exactly on first crossing
threshold_semantics.vernalization_completion: IDSL=2 ordering must distinguish forced completion during phenology-rate calculation from saturation completion after the crop update
threshold_semantics.maturity_or_harvest: legacy end check occurs after day-end crop evolution and must not be silently moved before final growth
threshold_semantics.leaf_cohort_creation: exactly one new cohort shift per admitted one-day crop event
threshold_semantics.leaf_ageing: one event-local FYSDEL*1-day age increment per retained cohort
threshold_semantics.root_depth_change: option-dependent root extension happens once after the WOFOST update, not per Richards substep

scheduler_responsibilities: run as many accepted soil-water substeps as needed inside the window
request one crop finalization at the physical cadence
crop_module_does_not_know: file paths or weather record cursors
whether soil-water used one or many solver substeps
calendar arrays or global day counters

future_generalization_gate.subdaily_crop_event: requires independent scientific qualification of phenology, cohort, threshold and aggregation equivalence
future_generalization_gate.multi_day_single_event: requires independent scientific qualification; repeating a daily event N times is not the same contract as one N-day update
